rule: for i = 0,1,2,...: run volcano-rho search with seed = stream + i; walk the hit with ca volcano (--radius 40 --max-vertices 20000, --seed 20261017); take the FIRST hit that satisfies the volcano's criteria; every rejected seed and its reason is logged in census/search_log.jsonl. Size limits are budget rules, not outcome rules.

criteria.common: walk complete (no vertex with level -1, count < max-vertices), prime-order subgroup n >= 2^18 with cofactor <= 64, n not divisible by ell
criteria.V1: ell=2, depth=4, crater split, p = 1 mod 8, special_j_skipped = 0, total vertices <= 400
criteria.V2: ell=3, depth=3, crater split, special_j_skipped = 0, total vertices <= 400
criteria.V3: ell=2, depth=4, j=0 root (D_K=-3, inert crater, one vertex) found with --j0, p = 1 mod 24, r = 1 mod 3 (rho.cubic needs 3 | r-1), walk complete (special_j_skipped may be > 0 only because child->root edges return to j=0)
criteria.V4: the quadratic twist of the V1 root by the least quadratic non-residue d: (a d^2, b d^3); same walk checks; r = largest prime factor of p+1+t, accepted whatever the cofactor if r >= 2^16 (stretch; reported if not)
